name: 臺北市政府消防局
note: Model = HQ group of blender/build_xinyi_street.py (origin at the Songren / Zhongxiao intersection centre). Anchored by the podium's NW corner (model 30,-27) to the official NW corner (10.9 m E, 28.6 m S of the OSM intersection node 121.5687101, 25.0411021); the model's road widths were estimated wider than the real ones, so the anchor is not the real intersection. Official tower 288599 has roof points only (no walls), hence collider = true. Model height (~56 m) is taller than the official LOD1 (~44 m).
